camel_example: aliyun cloudapi CreateIpControl --region cn-hangzhou --IpControlType ALLOW --IpControlName controlNameTest
description_en: Creates an IP access control policy in a region
description_zh: 在某个地域下新增IP访问控制
kebab_example: aliyun cloudapi create-ip-control --ip-control-name controlNameTest --ip-control-type ALLOW --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateIpControl

parameters.help_en: The name of the IP access control policy. The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, and underscores (_). It cannot start with an underscore
parameters.help_zh: IP访问控制名称。支持大小写英文字母、中文、数字、下划线（_）、长度为`[4,50]`个字符, 且不能以下划线开头
parameters.name: ip_control_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the IP access control policy. Valid values:

ALLOW: The IP access control policy is a whitelist.
REFUSE: The IP access control policy is a blacklist
parameters.help_zh:
IP访问控制类型：

ALLOW：IP访问控制为白名单类型
REFUSE：IP访问控制为黑名单类型
parameters.name: ip_control_type

parameters.help_en: The description of the IP access control policy. The description can be up to 200 characters in length
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en:
The AppId restricted by the policy. You can add an AppId restriction only when the control type is whitelist (IpControlType is ALLOW).

You can add only one AppId at a time.
If this parameter is empty, no AppId restriction is applied.
If this parameter is not empty, the AppId is restricted in addition to the IP address restriction.
If this parameter is not empty and the security authentication of the API is set to No Authentication, all API calls are restricted. Take note of this.
If the control type is blacklist (IpControlType is REFUSE) and this parameter is not empty, API Gateway automatically ignores this value and applies only the IP address restriction.
Valid values of N in IpControlPolicys.N: 1 to 100
fields.help_zh:
策略限制的AppId，只有控制类型为白名单（即 IpControlType为ALLOW）时，才可同时增加AppId的限制。

一次只能增加一个；
为空表示没有AppId的限制；
当该值不为空，表示在有IP限制的同时，还限制访问的AppId；
当该值不为空，如果API的安全认证为“无认证”，将限制所有的API调用，请注意；
当黑名单（IpControlType为REFUSE）时，该值不为空，API网关会自动忽略该值，只设置IP的限制；
IpControlPolicys.N 中N的取值范围：`[1,100]`；
fields.name: app_id

fields.help_en:
The IP address or CIDR block of the specific policy.

To specify a policy when you create the access control policy, this parameter is required.
For each policy, you can specify multiple IP addresses or CIDR blocks. Separate multiple values with semicolons (;). You can add up to 10 values.
Valid values for N in IpControlPolicys.N: 1 to 100
fields.help_zh:
具体策略的IP或者IP段

当要在创建访问控制时指定策略，该值不能为空；
每条策略的IP或者IP段，多个请用英文分号（;）分割，最多添加10个；
IpControlPolicys.N 中N的取值范围：`[1,100]`
fields.name: cidr_ip

parameters.help_en: The array of IP control policies, which contains the information items of the policies
parameters.help_zh: 由ipcontrolpolicys组成的数组格式，返回策略的信息项
parameters.name: ip_control_policys

IpControlId.description_en: The ID of the IP access control policy
